description_en: Call the ListServiceInstanceBill operation to query bills for service instances
description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceBill查询服务实例账单
kebab_example: aliyun computenest list-service-instance-bill --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAVz7BQqj2xtiNSC3d3RAD38= --service-instance-id si-49793f3bfa034ec6a990 --billing-cycle 2024-05 --granularity DAILY --billing-date 2025-04-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceBill

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service instance
parameters.name: service_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle in YYYY-MM format. Only billing cycles in the last 18 months are supported
parameters.help_zh: 账期YYYY－MM。仅支持最近18个月账期
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The granularity of the bills to query. Valid values:

MONTHLY: monthly. The data is consistent with the bills aggregated by billing cycle in the User Center.

DAILY: daily. The data is consistent with the bills aggregated by day in the User Center.

If you set this parameter to DAILY, you must also specify BillingDate
parameters.help_zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值：
MONTHLY：月。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-账期”账单一致。
DAILY：日。与“费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-按天”账单一致。

选择DAILY需指定BillingDate
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when Granularity is set to DAILY. The format is YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.help_zh: 账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: billing_date

Item.description_en: A list of billing information for the service instance
Item.description_zh: 备份计划计费信息列表

items.description_en: The billing information for the service instance
items.description_zh: 备份计划计费信息列表

BillingCycle.description_en:
The billing cycle of the computing resources for the instance. This parameter is supported only for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

Day: daily billing.

Month: monthly billing
BillingCycle.description_zh:
实例计算资源计费周期，仅支持实例级后付费。
取值

Day：按天计费。

Month：按月计费

BillingDate.description_en: The billing date in YYYY-MM-DD format. This parameter is returned only when Granularity is set to DAILY
BillingDate.description_zh: 账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD

BillingItemCode.description_en: The code of the billable item

Currency.description_en:
The currency. Valid values:

CNY: Chinese Yuan.

USD: US Dollar.

JPY: Japanese Yen
Currency.description_zh:
币种。取值范围：
CNY：人民币。
USD：美元。
JPY：日元

DeductedByResourcePackage.description_en: The amount deducted by a resource plan

ListPriceUnit.description_en: The unit of the list price

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the resource belongs

SplitBillingCycle.description_en: The month of the split bill

SubscriptionType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: subscription.

PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
SubscriptionType.description_zh:
付费类型，取值：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行

NextToken.description_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
